Temporal focus:

T2. Forward-looking immediate [YES] — contract already active, data modernisation underway
T3. Long-term development [YES] — AI-driven digitisation, cloud infrastructure, potential re-opening of Venezuelan oilfields to investment

Synopsis:
SLB has signed a contract with Venezuelan state oil company PDVSA granting access to the country's oilfield data — the world's largest crude reserves. The deal covers data management, AI-driven modernisation, and technology transfer, aiming to rebuild PDVSA's geological and production databases after years of neglect and a recent ransomware attack. Payment mechanics remain unresolved given U.S. sanctions controlling Venezuelan oil revenues. The contract signals a cautious re-engagement of international oil services firms with Venezuela's upstream sector.
